description: This PHP source file generates a report of test cases created per user within a specific project, incorporating functionalities for data retrieval, display, and CSV download. It includes definitions for initializing the GUI, handling user inputs, filtering data, and rendering tables.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class utilized to generate and manage external data tables within the report, supporting custom behaviors, grouping, and sorting.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing test project management, providing methods to retrieve project details and test case data.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with configurations and determines which specific GUI initialization function to call based on action.

methods.name: initializeGuiForResult
methods.description: Initializes the GUI with test case result data according to filtering options, and prepares the data table for display.

methods.name: initGuiForCSVDownload
methods.description: Prepares and outputs a CSV file with test case data matching current filters, triggering the download process.

methods.name: initializeGuiForInput
methods.description: Configures the GUI to accept user inputs for filtering, including date ranges and user selections.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes report parameters from request or session, also validates test project ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has the necessary rights to access the report functionality.
